svg.title: Scala data pipeline illustration
svg.desc: An isometric-style illustration showing data flowing through a Scala and Spark pipeline: raw data sources on the left, a bronze layer, Scala transformer in the center, silver and gold layers, and a data warehouse on the right.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the bronze layer in a data pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How do you read CSV files in Spark Scala?')

sendPrompt('What is the purpose of a bronze layer in a medallion architecture?')
sendPrompt('How does the SilverTransformer work in this Scala pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What is the silver layer and what does it contain?')
sendPrompt('What is the gold layer used for in data engineering?')
sendPrompt('How do you connect a data warehouse to a Spark pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How do BI dashboards consume data from a gold layer?')
sendPrompt('How do ML models consume data from a data pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How do APIs serve data from a Spark pipeline?')

svg.text: Compile-time schema checks stop bad data before it reaches silver or gold
Tap any layer to learn more
